offline. Files copied unchanged from the npm package `pdfjs-dist@4.10.38`
(integrity sha512-/Y3fcFrXEAsMjJXeL9J8+ZG9U01LbuWaYypvDW2ycW1jL269L3js3DVBjDJ0Up9Np1uqDXsDrRihHANhZOlwdQ==):
